title: On Applying for the post in the office
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：apply　|　正文 360 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 apply 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the elder ① applied for the post in the office year after year, and every youth in the village said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the elder ② applies for the post in the office for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ apply for the post in the office at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ applied for the post in the office before — a line in the memoir for November 1968 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Applying for the post in the office year after year, the elder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far gate, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ apply a thin coat of oil for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Apply a thin coat of oil at once and never mention it again.

By 1981 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the memoir, and a new youth from the next village ⑧ applies a thin coat of oil year after year every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the gate, said nothing at all; she simply  applied for the post in the office again when nobody else would.

To apply for the post in the office, my mother said in 1986, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the village remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the village forgets, somebody applies for the post in the office for the whole place again and somebody must apply for the post in the office year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 申请（一般过去式 applied for the post in the office：1974 年长者头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 申请（一般现在 applies for the post in the office：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 申请（不定式 to apply for the post in the office：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 申请（过去完成时 had applied for the post in the office：1968 年十一月的回忆录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 申请（动名词 applying for the post in the office 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 涂抹（apply a thin coat of oil：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去涂抹薄薄一层油）
G. v. 涂抹（apply a thin coat of oil：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 申请（后段两处：新来的后生照例 applies a thin coat of oil，而母亲又一次 applied for the post in the office）

items.q: applied for the post in the office
applies for the post in the office
to apply for the post in the office
applied for the post in the office before
applying for the post in the office
apply a thin coat of oil for the whole place
apply a thin coat of oil at once
applies a thin coat of oil year after year

answers.why: apply 意为“申请”，1974 年长者年年地申请事务所里那个职位，那是村子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 applied。
apply 意为“申请”，自那以后长者替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 applies。
apply 意为“申请”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯申请事务所里那个职位”，此处为不定式 to apply for the post in the office。
apply 意为“申请”，回忆录里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1981 年之前就有人申请过，故用过去完成时 had applied。
apply 意为“申请”，长者说“申请事务所里那个职位这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 applying for the post in the office 作主语。
apply 意为“涂抹”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去涂抹薄薄一层油”，should ever 之后用原形 apply a thin coat of oil。
apply 意为“涂抹”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻涂抹薄薄一层油（apply a thin coat of oil at once），以后再也不要提起。
apply 意为“申请”，新来的后生每个年头都照例涂抹薄薄一层油，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 applies。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1974 年，长者年年地申请事务所里那个职位；村子里每一个后生都说这是头一回。（applied for the post in the office）
多年以后，长者仍替所有人做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（applies for the post in the office）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯申请事务所里那个职位这件事本身。（to apply for the post in the office）
早在 1968 年就有人申请事务所里那个职位，十一月那天回忆录上的一行字就是证据。（had applied for the post in the office）
长者说过，年年地申请事务所里那个职位这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（applying for the post in the office 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻涂抹薄薄一层油，以后再也不要提起。（apply a thin coat of oil，祈使句）
answers: In 1974 the elder applied for the post in the office year after year, and every youth in the village said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three years on, the elder still applies for the post in the office for the whole place without being asked.
My mother said later that to apply for the post in the office at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had applied for the post in the office long before 1981, and the line in the memoir for November proves it.
Applying for the post in the office year after year, the elder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Apply a thin coat of oil at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 apply 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1974 the elder applied for the post in the office year after year, and nobody in the village forgot it.
Even now the elder applies for the post in the office for the whole place whenever the village asks.
Applying for the post in the office year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever apply a thin coat of oil for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new youth from the next village applies a thin coat of oil year after year every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother applied for the post in the office again, and the village remembered that half.
